lines: Three thousand dollars buys you one designer bag. Or thirty replicas.
At about a hundred dollars each, that's a new style every month, for two and a half years.
One bag matches some of your outfits. Thirty match all of them.
Work, the gym, date night, a weekend away. There's a bag for every plan.
And if one gets scuffed or lost, you've still got twenty-nine.
One logo, or thirty looks? Which would you pick?
